name: Tobinstown Lodge
bedsNote: + ground-floor office/bedroom next to a ground-floor bathroom
heating: Two solid-fuel stoves (no central heating system stated)
tagline: A four-bed country lodge on 3.2 acres between Tullow and Rathvilly in north Carlow, about 5 km from Tullow.

pros.detail: 1.28 ha: the most land in this batch, plenty for two vizslas.

pros.text: Ground-floor office/bedroom with its own bathroom nearby
pros.detail: Office/bedroom (3.95 × 3.85 m) downstairs, beside a large ground-floor bathroom (4.28 × 3.22 m) with double shower and clawfoot bath.
About 2,450 sq ft, inside the 140–280 m² target; four bedrooms upstairs plus the ground-floor room.
SuperValu, Tesco, Aldi and Lidl, plus Tullow Community School (901 pupils, mixed, over 80% to third level in 2016).
Open countryside between Tullow and Rathvilly; no estate neighbours.
Two stables, sheds, a yard with a crush and a gated paddock: good for dogs, and storage or workshop space.

cons.detail: Naas General ~41 km (adults 16+ only), St Luke's Kilkenny ~43 km, Portlaoise ~47 km, all as the crow flies.
Carlow station is ~17 km (about 8 trains a weekday, ~1h to Heuston); Kildare ~39 km.
BER C3 with no central heating, oil or heat pump mentioned; budget a rough €20–30k for a heat pump and radiators (before SEAI grants) if that's confirmed.
St Patrick's NS (199 pupils) 4.2 km; Ballyconnell NS 4.5 km. Every school run is a drive.
Nearest shop is in Rathvilly, about 4–5 km.
Well pump replaced last year; ask for a water test and septic certification.
A converted country pub with dual road frontage: check traffic on both roads, confirm residential planning and certification for the change of use, and check the boundary walls keep the dogs in.

trips.note: About 200–207 pupils, Catholic, co-ed, DEIS, one special class.

rating.basis: DEIS school with a stable roll (down 2% since 2019/20); the gov.ie inspection report couldn't be fetched.

trips.note: Mixed, inter-denominational, non-fee-paying, 901 pupils, about 7 km.

rating.basis: Over 80% progression to third level in the 2016 feeder tables (KCLR); a large, growing mixed school (901). Recent Irish Times figures couldn't be read.

trips.label: Train to Dublin
trips.note: Carlow: about 10 trains a weekday, ~1h to Heuston. Kildare has far more trains but is a longer drive.

trips.label: Flight home
trips.note: The trip you and your parents will make most.

ai.why: Three acres, right size, a ground-floor room with a bathroom. BER C3 on stoves only, a former pub on two roads, far from an all-ages ED.

internet.detail: NBI fibre likely or imminent; NBI began building near Tullow in July 2025 and expects Carlow done by end-2026. Check R93 FK76 on nbi.ie.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The ground-floor office could be a bedroom, with a bathroom nearby.
